sample_scope.source_format: XLSM extension over a synthetic OOXML package

comparison.path_identity_note: Rust canonical paths may use the Windows extended-path prefix; comparison normalized that prefix and verified the same file.

limitations: The synthetic XLSM has no VBA parts and does not validate real macro-enabled workbook behavior.
The user-provided S5 sample subtree contained 120 XLSX and no XLSM files.
Only sheet-name metadata matching is covered; XLSM value reading, editing, VBA preservation, Linux/deb, and full S5 workflow are not covered.
Audit shared capability request #8 remains unresolved.
